# Certification Authority

## Summary
The body whose name stands behind a certificate: `name`, the signatory who signs (`signatoryName`, `signatoryTitle`), the `seal` image, a verification base URL, a certificate `numberPrefix` and the `lastSequence` counter. Domain-neutral: an academy, a safety regulator and an ISO certification body carry the same shape.

```ts
import { CertificationAuthority } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/audit/certification-authority';

@field authority = linksTo(() => CertificationAuthority);
```

A certificate card links the authority that issued it and takes its number from the prefix and the next sequence.

**`lastSequence` is the one mutable fact.** A realm has no global counter, so the authority holds its own; whatever issues a certificate increments it, and the edit form shows it read-only so it is not hand-edited out of order. Its edit form is built on the shared Sectioned Edit.

## Example
`CertificationAuthority/northwind-academy`.

## Non-goals
Not an organisation directory entry, and it does not issue certificates itself.
